## Boundary checklist

- [ ] I did not turn registration, provenance, custody, hosting or external evidence into sovereign authority.
- [ ] I did not treat a valid signature or protocol-valid record as objective external truth.
- [ ] I preserved historical signed interpretation rather than silently rewriting prior semantics.
- [ ] I added/updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private keys, recovery material and private user/business data.
- [ ] I identified any conformance-vector or public-specification impact above.

## Reviewer notes

Call out anything that deserves especially careful review. Small, reviewable PRs are preferred; a PR does not need to solve the whole protocol area to be useful.
